description: Write an integer out in Persian words (عدد به حروف), for example 1234 as هزار و دویست و سی و چهار. Use it for Persian invoices, cheque amounts, legal and official forms, and display. Returns the number spelled in Persian words. ($0.01 per call, USDC on Base)

number.description: integer, string digits, commas or Persian digits

name: fa_numberToWords
